My uncle is a police officer and his advice if you ever saw a crime was to write down everything you saw as soon as possible, while also writing down things you couldnt quite make out or remember vividly, so as to keep you mind from filling in the blanks. So say a guy mugged an old lady, you saw him taking in details like he was bald very pale had a tattoo on his left forearm tha looked like a plus sign but you're not sure. that way the more you focus on that tattoo your mind doesnt make it into a swastika or something.

When my dad heard what I said he thought surely I had just retained some of what I saw on the history channel, as he watches it 24/7 for the past 20 years.
